title: AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 end of support

canonical_premises.statement: AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 will continue receiving updates.
canonical_premises.old_excerpt: The v2 SDK is expected to continue receiving updates.

canonical_premises.statement: Migrate to v3 if AWS ends support for v2.
canonical_premises.old_excerpt: Revisit a v3 migration if AWS ends v2 support.
